scope: Read-only frozen RTL/software evidence for unified 200 trials; no fit or new execution.

conclusions.W: Exact-DID HPM S1_PTW event, once per miss-triggered S1 walk attempt; not store/PTE/cycle/DMA-copy count. Success and S1-only assumptions apply to L relation.
conclusions.stage: Sv39 S1, S2 Bare; 4KiB level3 leaf (Sv39 architectural level0)
conclusions.ddtc: Two active DIDs fit DDTC8 and successful premeasurement warmup loads contexts. Stable hits expected absent external invalidation/other traffic; not measured DDTC hit proof.
conclusions.pdtc: Bypassed for this load, not warm-hit; conf PV0 and DC PDTV0 use fsc directly.
conclusions.DS: AR/AW/W input delay; R/B output delay; DS0 direct wiring bypass. Each of three serial PTE reads crosses AR and R once.
conclusions.DS_idle_ready_formula: D(d)=0 for direct DS0;1 for d1 special;d+2 for d>1 if ready and no other contention, counted from first valid in Idle to release. Only d0,25,50,100 used.
conclusions.DS_single_walk_minimum_withholding: 3*(D_in+D_out)=6*(d+2) for equal d>1 versus direct; nonzero-to-nonzero marginal6*delta_d. This is a source-FSM ideal-ready deduction, not new measurement or additive whole-window attribution.
conclusions.burst_event_bound: Each successful ordinary incoming AR/AW burst has at most one S1 event; event increment precedes corresponding data AR/AW forwarding and hence RLAST/B completion.

limits: No board, build, simulation, or model fit run; source hash verification only.
L3 does not imply all DS traffic is3W: cold DC/PDT/CQ/FQ/MSI/control traffic is separate; DDTC/PDTW are not counted by S1 W.
HPM software snapshots are non-atomic and differ from observer hardware window; W observed in software interval cannot be blindly assigned to hardware window.
Three PTE accesses and six delayed channels do not mean whole V time increases by6dW: data overlap, queuing, backpressure and bus contention matter.
DDTC-hit steady-state expectation assumes no external context invalidation or new competing device contexts during measurement.
No raw dynamic PTE/DS transaction trace exists in this task; no measured per-PTE latency or per-walk window attribution claimed.
